mu_name_from: OURS. Group 13 number 26 is free in 0.75. Named for its element. docs/jewellery.md, 'Stings'.
why_this_one: The rings of every element (the user, 2026-10-08: 'ring of poison need poison resistance and poison damage', 'we need also ring of lighting with same logic, ring of fire with same logic, and ring of wind with same logic'). It resists lightning (resists a monster's push), and a chance on a landed blow to throw a bolt on the monster that pushes it (sim::ringStingChance).
profile_note: As Gem05: a small painted sheet on a made object seen close.

stats.note: Ours, on MU's Ring of Poison row: a 1x1 piece, durability 50, every class, level asked its drop level.
stats.resistance_note: 1 a plus in this element, the largest of the worn pieces counting (sim/items.h, jewellery).
